data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 asserts a shared 'Under-Layer Monoculture' as the causal mechanism, but provides no derivation or evidence that this layer is a genuine shared cause rather than an assumption. The problem asks for evidence distinguishing truly independent failures from those merely appearing uncorrelated until a shared cause is found; SRC_002's own counterconditions (distinct infrastructure providers, heterogeneous protocols) directly concede that the supposed monoculture can be absent, yet it gives no causal criterion for when the under-layer actually couples node failures versus when nodes remain independent. Thus the proposed causal link ('shared substrate -> correlated failure') is not operationalized: no test, observable, or propagation path is specified to detect the hidden common cause it posits.
